decisions.reason: As an accessory building on the established offer, its value is relatively clear and keeping it costs little, so the real option remains open.
It is distant from the firm's core and has shown only a limited website presence, suggesting its option value is unlikely to be realized, so abandoning it frees resources.
Close to the established offer and marketed as a product line with several models, it represents an exercised option with low remaining uncertainty, so it is kept.
Building on the established offer as an automatic tool change system, it has low keeping costs and complements existing machines, so the option stays open.
